F01-b-P3.detail: Dashboard provides no period-over-period comparison configuration or results

F02-a-P3.detail: Valid assembly behavior is cross-covered by F02-k, but serialized-unit assignment is unavailable.

F02-k.detail: Valid 2A+3B recipe, availability 2, component value 47 and sale of two kits deducting 4A/6B pass; zero input silently becomes one. A cross-branch boundary sale succeeds with no components in the recorded sale branch and drives component stock negative.

F02-l.detail: Categories have no dynamic field definitions or schema assignment

F03-g.detail: Branch inventory units/value reconciled against independently paginated products. Period-scoped sales are presented; sales recognition/date-boundary and cross-branch financial eligibility are not fully certified.

F04-e.detail: Positive two-item API voucher and negative-stock atomicity control pass; the native form accepts only one item.

F05-e.detail: Transfers have no printable dispatch manifest or delivery slip

F05-f.detail: In-transit receipt has no damage, shortage or discrepancy dispute entry

F06-d.detail: Stock counts cannot be scheduled or scoped to a category

F06-e.detail: Count sheet has no barcode-driven counting workflow

F07-a.detail: Standalone owned lots persist through the diagnostic API; manufacturer-lot capture during receipt is unavailable, and the batch selector cannot reach later-page products.

F07-b.detail: Per-lot dates and reload/display pass. Entering zero quantity silently creates a one-unit lot; native product selection also has the first-page limitation.

F07-c.detail: Expired, tomorrow-expiry and fresh lots display the expected visual states; matching filters show each owned lot. This requirement asks for visual indicators, not outbound delivery.

F07-d.detail: An owned expiry-enabled product is sold four times with receipt order opposed to expiry order. The native priority is consistent through first-lot exhaustion; remaining lot totals reconcile with independent physical stock. No claim of two separately selectable modes.

F07-e.detail: Expired batches expose delete metadata but no supervised stock disposal workflow

F08-l.detail: Offline checkout fails without storing a durable queued sale

F08-m.detail: POS has no customer loyalty balance or redemption workflow

F10-a.detail: Diagnostic processing-enabled order progresses through queue states. Native Processing product creation saves requires_processing=false and its normal POS sale does not create a ticket.

F10-b.detail: Processing ticket editor cannot assign a technician, service bay or table

F10-c.detail: Order queue has no thermal work-order ticket generation action

F12-f.detail: Recurring contract billing cannot be configured

F12-g.detail: Invoice editor has no per-invoice currency or recorded exchange rate

F12-h.detail: Invoice Due Reminders and email channel controls exist in Notifications > Settings. Actual overdue email dispatch/delivery cannot be certified without a controlled QA inbox.

F13-f.detail: Standalone credit creation succeeds, but Save as Draft submits Open and adds stock without a receiving choice; all owned stock changes compensated.

F14-a.detail: A valid supplemental debit draft with total 100 persists. Issued accounting and dedicated freight/service-line coverage are not fully verified.

F14-b.detail: A new owned debit note retains its selected synthetic paid invoice ID after reload and displays that reference on the printable document.

F14-c.detail: Authenticated browser print view and A4 PDF preserve the debit number, customer, selected product name/SKU and amount; PDF visually reviewed. Email dispatch lacks a controlled inbox; physical printing skipped.

F15-e.detail: Low-stock items have no automatic purchase-order reordering workflow

F15-f.detail: Purchase-order detail has no direct supplier email transmission action

F16-e.detail: Goods receiving cannot capture manufacturer lots or lot expiry dates

F17-d.detail: Bill entry provides PO linking but no three-way receipt reconciliation

F18-e.detail: Owned supplier mapping stores its vendor-specific SKU, preferred flag and lead time; attach/read/detach pass. The native catalogue hides the vendor SKU and searching that SKU returns no product.

F18-f.detail: Supplier export downloads profile fields rather than an account statement

F19-e.detail: Customer groups and automatic pricing tiers cannot be configured

F19-f.detail: Customer account UI has no credit enablement or debt ceiling configuration

F20-g.detail: Revenue and revenue-minus-recorded-cost/displayed gross margin arithmetic pass. Net-margin deep dive is missing; catalogue-versus-recorded COGS provenance remains unverified.

F20-h.detail: A controlled +1 adjustment appears as a new stock movement with the correct resulting balance; stock restored. Dedicated velocity metric definitions and historical reconciliation are not fully certified.

F20-i.detail: AR buckets are reconstructed from live invoice dates/balances and totals reconcile. Supplier/creditor aging is absent from the report catalogue/Bills controls.

F21-a.detail: Report builder only saves predefined report choices rather than custom dimensions and metrics

F21-b.detail: Filtered saved template create/reload/run/delete passes. Valid unfiltered templates return filters as [] and disappear from the client list.

F21-c.detail: Cadence/recipient schedule form inspected. No active schedule created without a controlled inbox; cron firing, delivered CSV and retry behavior are unverified.

F22-e.detail: Document Builder has presets and form controls but no drag-and-drop design canvas

F22-f.detail: Invalid extension is rejected. Valid native TTF upload loses bytes and returns 422; diagnostic multipart upload/list/exact file-hash/delete pass without changing original fonts.

F23-f.detail: Users & Roles has no custom role or granular permission matrix editor

F24-d.detail: Enable control is available after the real account load. Enrollment/login/time-window/replay tests require an isolated activated account; shared owner factors were preserved.

F24-e.detail: Recovery code generation, one-time use and recovery login depend on isolated TOTP enrollment; no suitable activated account is available.

F24-f.detail: Revoked automation session retains authenticated account access

F25-c.detail: Live campaign product archive transitions contain active-to-archived old/new values; the UI has diff columns and exported values preserve them.

F25-d.detail: Native filtered CSV export includes Old/New Value columns and its row count matches the complete filtered paginated result. JSON export is not exposed; the slash-format requirement needs confirmation before full acceptance.

F26-a.detail: Owned key naming/create/list/rotate/revoke/delete pass. Secrets are absent from list data; explicit empty-session controls accept the active key and refuse invalid/old/revoked keys. Secrets remain private.

F26-b.detail: Global read-only denial (403) and write-enabled update (200 plus independent persistence) pass on an owned product. Anonymous/invalid credentials return 401. Per-resource restricted scopes are not exposed/tested.

F26-c.detail: API documentation lacks a resource reference and falsely says API keys cannot authenticate

F26-d.detail: Webhook subscriptions omit the three events required by the specification

F26-e.detail: No controlled webhook receiver exists and no endpoint is registered. Actual signed deliveries, persisted delivery logs and manual retry outcomes are not verified. A page notice is not backend proof.

F27-c.detail: Physical ESC/POS network/serial connection and paper output skipped at user request. Software connect controls and browser API availability inspected; no hardware mock counted as acceptance.

F27-d.detail: Physical RJ11 cash drawer kick/pulse skipped at user request because no drawer/printer is connected.

F27-e.detail: Software label generation is unavailable. Physical label-printer execution is separately skipped at user request.

F28-f.detail: Advanced JSON export only shows a toast, with no job/download. No automated backup configuration/history workflow is exposed; unseen backend jobs/restoration are not certified.

F29-d.detail: Actual notification settings/channel preferences inspected without saving changes. No controlled email inbox, SMS number/gateway or delivery receiver is available for end-to-end verification.

F30-d.detail: Positive/negative FAQ search and answer expansion pass; no video guides are available.

F30-e.detail: Changelog route, visible release entries and descending dates pass. The static 2025 history is not certified as current deployment/release provenance; no authoritative backend build revision is available.

positives: Valid BOM save, availability and automatic component deductions through POS.
Positive multi-item API adjustments and atomic negative-stock rejection; transfer stock lifecycle and compensation.
Lot dates/visual expiry filters and automatic native lot priority through depletion, reconciled to physical balances.
Debit invoice linkage, amount, product identity and visually reviewed A4 PDF.
Controlled stock movement entry and invoice-based AR aging reconciliation.
Filtered saved report persistence/run/delete; before/after audit values and complete filtered CSV export.
Active API key read and write scopes, negative credentials, rotation, revocation and deletion.
FAQ positive/negative search and answer expansion.
Supplier-specific SKU/preferred mapping persists through the API and the owned relation is removed; native vendor SKU display/search has a confirmed gap.
dependencies: Physical ESC/POS network/serial printing, cash drawer pulse, scanner devices and label paper output were skipped at the user's request. Software availability was still inspected.
No controlled QA email inbox, SMS receiver/gateway or webhook receiver: overdue email, cron report email, notification transports and webhook delivery/signatures/logs/retries remain unverified.
No isolated activated account: TOTP enrollment/login/replay and recovery-code generation/one-use/recovery remain blocked. Shared owner authentication factors and unrelated sessions were preserved.
Per-resource API scopes, full branch sales/velocity analysis, issued service/freight debit accounting and current changelog provenance are partial.
Gross COGS provenance and whether CSV/JSON requires both formats are observations awaiting policy/requirement confirmation, not additional confirmed bugs.
cleanup: Owned fixture stock was restored across every branch and checked in the archived catalogue, owned products archived with fresh server verification, owned lots/keys/report templates/diagnostic fonts deleted and the owned supplier relation detached, and the owned scan count abandoned. Existing MVP fonts 1/2 remain. An early archive cleanup race was corrected and its single zero-stock owned product repaired. Synthetic QA sales, credits, debit drafts, POs, vendor and audit/adjustment history are retained. No active email schedule or external webhook endpoint was created; no payment gateway, real email/SMS send or physical device command was requested. Each module ends only its own QA login session.
